purpose: Reviewable staging plan for public corresponding-source delivery of the five bundled WASM engines. Publication requires owner confirmation of the hosting location and an explicit external release action; this file alone never publishes anything.

urlPlan.decidedByOwner: 2026-09-21: archives go to GitHub Releases on web-casa/z8work, plus a generated download page at https://z8.work/desktop-source/ on the site
requirements: Upload the GitHub release (with SHA256SUMS as an asset) before deploying the site page that links to it
Permanent HTTPS URLs that outlive individual product releases
Free public access without account, interstitial or region block
Served bytes must hash exactly to the per-artifact sha256 recorded here
Pandoc archive is ~1.1 GiB; a single GitHub release asset must carry it
urlPlan.replacementPolicy: If bytes ever must change, publish a new tag (desktop-source-2, ...) with new file names and record the supersession here; never mutate published assets.

retentionPolicy: Keep every published archive and its exact bytes retrievable for as long as any distributed desktop binary binds to it; if a file must be replaced, publish it under a new name and record the supersession here instead of mutating published bytes.

artifacts.contentsNote: Pandoc source at the fixed commit, 6 vendored git dependencies, 127 pinned Hackage package tarballs, GHC/WASI toolchain archives, pinned Debian builder image, build scripts and two recorded build digests (not byte-identical).
ffmpeg.wasm wrapper, FFmpeg and 16 pinned dependency trees, Emscripten, build configuration and rebuild instructions; rebuilt WASM and JS are byte-identical to the shipped files.
magick-wasm and Magick.Native sources plus the 23 pinned embedded-library dependency trees; shipped WASM is byte-identical to the official upstream release asset.
MuPDF source with exact third-party submodule trees, git-blob audit metadata, Emscripten toolchain and rebuild scripts; rebuilt WASM and JS files are byte-identical to the shipped files.
vert-wasm source with Cargo.lock and 25 vendored crates, plus rebuild toolchain pinning; rebuilt WASM is byte-identical to the shipped file.
